terra.problem: The joke makes the imagined power of God's statute the punchline. Humor must not target Scripture.
“It's meant to be” asserts an intended effect for the picture that the text does not state. The preceding “I think” marks the assessment as heavy, not clearly the claim of intent.
“Born there” treats native-born Israelites as people born in the land, although the passage describes Israel being brought into it. It also reduces the foreigner to anyone living there.
“I wish it were that easy” suggests Papa wishes Israel could defile the land without consequence, an inappropriate response to the serious practices in the passage.
